title: HB1176 (110th General Assembly): As introduced, reduces the penalty for the offense of carrying a handgun without a permit and with the intent to go armed to a Class C misdemeanor with a $25 fine for a first offense or $50 for a second or subsequent offense and requires a citation to be issued in lieu of arrest. - Amends TCA Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13 and Title 40.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2017-02-09; official copy via LegiScan getBillText doc 1505558)
provenance.note: Draft as filed, 2017-02-09 (HB 1176 / SB 339, one document). Introduced version; no votes recorded. Amendments, if any, are not in this text. Section 1 replaces all of 39-17-1307(a); (a)(2) sets penalties for non-handgun firearms carry.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307(a)): (1) A person commits an offense who carries with the intent to go armed: (A) A firearm other than a handgun or a club; or (B) A handgun without authorization under § 39-17-1315 or § 39-17-1351.
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307(a)): (A) A first violation of subdivision (a)(1)(B) is a Class C misdemeanor punishable only by a fine of twenty-five dollars ($25.00).
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307(a)): (B) A second or subsequent violation of subdivision (a)(1)(B) is a Class C misdemeanor punishable only by a fine of fifty dollars ($50.00). (C) A person who violates subdivision (a)(1)(B) shall be issued a citation in lieu of arrest in accordance with § 40-7-118, and a law enforcement officer shall not confiscate the person's handgun solely for a violation of subdivision (a)(1)(B).
SECTION 2 (TCA 40-7-118(b)(3)): The offense of carrying a handgun without authorization, in violation of § 39-17-1307(a)(1)(B);
